name: room-c5h-qwen-sketch: Qwen 2.1 Pro draws the whole room from the specification and the wordless layout sketches, with no finished wall as a reference
notes: In the room run, Qwen's anchor wall (sketch only) was its first fully compliant wall, and its three walls drawn with finished walls attached came back speckled with noise and with the referenced walls' furniture copied in. So: words and the sketch, nothing else, same seed on every wall for a steady hand.

Follow its positions exactly and ignore its look entirely; it is a plan, not the style.
cases.note: layout sketch only, no finished wall attached
